title: Add an nxs- component to the platform's component library
description: Scaffolds a standalone nxs- component in libs/shared/satori-components with its spec, story and Storybook Overview page, registers it by ID in provideNxsComponents() for one of the slots that render a component, exports it, documents the ID in docs/extension-reference.md, and adds its section and row to docs/satori-components/with-and-without-satori.md.

name.description: Component name, kebab-case. Becomes nxs-<name>, Nxs<Name>Component and nxs.<slot>.<camelCase>.

slot.description: The slot that will place it. Only these four render a component by ID.

project.description: The component library. Only the platform's own carries the nxs- prefix.
